items.meaning: 关键词 MUST 应按 RFC2119 中的描述解释。
220 响应表示已准备好开始 TLS。

items.constraint: 未被公开引用的 SMTP 服务器可以基于 TLS 协商期间提供的认证信息拒绝接收任何中继或本地投递邮件。

items.object: TLS negotiation
items.condition: that is not publicly referenced

items.meaning: 在这种情况下，服务器应返回指定的应答码。
items.constraint: In this case, the server SHOULD return the reply code: 530 Must issue a STARTTLS command first to every command other than NOOP, EHLO, STARTTLS, or QUIT.

items.condition: In this case

items.entity: 530 Must issue a STARTTLS command first

items.constraint: reply code is 530 Must issue a STARTTLS command first

items.constraint: status code to be returned SHOULD be 5.7.0
items.condition: If the client and server are using the ENHANCEDSTATUSCODES ESMTP extension [RFC2034]

items.meaning: 如果 TLS 握手失败，客户端应中止连接。

items.meaning: 当 SMTP 客户端使用管道时，STARTTLS 命令必须是组中的最后一条命令。

items.object: last command in a group
items.condition: If the SMTP client is using pipelining as defined in RFC 2920

items.meaning: TLS 握手完成后，双方必须立即根据所获得的认证和隐私情况决定是否继续。
items.constraint: both parties MUST immediately decide whether or not to continue based on the authentication and privacy achieved
items.action: decide whether or not to continue based on authentication and privacy achieved
items.object: whether or not to continue based on the authentication and privacy achieved
items.condition: After the TLS handshake has been completed

items.meaning: SMTP 客户端和服务器即使 TLS 协商未提供认证和/或隐私，也可以决定继续。
如果 SMTP 客户端认为认证或隐私级别不足以继续，则应在 TLS 协商完成后立即发出 SMTP QUIT 命令。
items.constraint: If the SMTP client decides that the level of authentication or privacy is not high enough for it to continue, it SHOULD issue an SMTP QUIT command immediately after the TLS negotiation is complete
items.action: issue an SMTP QUIT command immediately after the TLS negotiation is complete
items.object: SMTP QUIT command
items.condition: If the SMTP client decides that the level of authentication or privacy is not high enough for it to continue

items.meaning: 如果 SMTP 服务器认为认证或隐私级别不足以继续，则应对来自客户端的除 QUIT 命令外的每条 SMTP 命令回复 554 回复码。
items.constraint: If the SMTP server decides that the level of authentication or privacy is not high enough for it to continue, it SHOULD reply to every SMTP command from the client (other than a QUIT command) with the 554 reply code
items.action: reply to every SMTP command from the client with the 554 reply code
items.object: every SMTP command from the client (other than a QUIT command) with the 554 reply code
items.condition: If the SMTP server decides that the level of authentication or privacy is not high enough for it to continue

items.meaning: TLS 握手完成后，SMTP 协议重置到初始状态，即服务器发出 220 服务就绪问候后的 SMTP 状态。
服务器必须丢弃从客户端获得、但并非来自 TLS 协商本身的知识，例如 EHLO 命令的参数。
items.constraint: The server MUST discard any knowledge obtained from the client, such as the argument to the EHLO command, which was not obtained from the TLS negotiation itself
items.object: any knowledge obtained from the client, such as the argument to the EHLO command, which was not obtained from the TLS negotiation itself
items.condition: Upon completion of the TLS handshake

items.meaning: 客户端必须丢弃从服务器获得、但并非来自 TLS 协商本身的知识，例如 SMTP 服务扩展列表。
items.constraint: The client MUST discard any knowledge obtained from the server, such as the list of SMTP service extensions, which was not obtained from the TLS negotiation itself
items.object: any knowledge obtained from the server, such as the list of SMTP service extensions, which was not obtained from the TLS negotiation itself
items.condition: Upon completion of the TLS handshake

items.meaning: 客户端应在成功 TLS 协商后发送 EHLO 命令作为第一条命令。
items.constraint: The client SHOULD send an EHLO command as the first command after a successful TLS negotiation
items.action: send an EHLO command as the first command after a successful TLS negotiation
items.object: an EHLO command as the first command after a successful TLS negotiation
items.condition: after a successful TLS negotiation

items.meaning: TLS 握手后收到的 EHLO 命令所返回的 SMTP 服务扩展列表，可以不同于 TLS 握手前返回的列表。
items.constraint: The list of SMTP service extensions returned in response to an EHLO command received after the TLS handshake MAY be different than the list returned before the TLS handshake
items.action: be different than the list returned before the TLS handshake
items.object: The list of SMTP service extensions returned in response to an EHLO command received after the TLS handshake
items.condition: received after the TLS handshake

items.meaning: 服务器可能不想通告对特定 SASL 机制的支持，除非客户端在 TLS 握手期间发送了适当的客户端证书。
The client and server MUST know whether a TLS session is active.
items.constraint: Both the client and the server MUST know if there is a TLS session active.
items.object: if there is a TLS session active

items.meaning: A client MUST NOT attempt to start a TLS session when one is already active.
items.constraint: A client MUST NOT attempt to start a TLS session if a TLS session is already active.
items.object: a TLS session
items.condition: if a TLS session is already active

items.meaning: A server MUST NOT return the STARTTLS extension in response to an EHLO command received after a TLS handshake has completed.
items.constraint: A server MUST NOT return the STARTTLS extension in response to an EHLO command received after a TLS handshake has completed.
items.object: the STARTTLS extension
items.condition: in response to an EHLO command received after a TLS handshake has completed

items.meaning: STARTTLS is a valid ESMTP extension when used on the Submission port.
SMTP is not an end-to-end mechanism.
If an SMTP client/server pair adds TLS privacy, they are not securing the transport from the originating mail user agent to the recipient.
Delivery of a single piece of mail may go between more than two SMTP servers.
Adding TLS privacy to one pair of servers does not mean that the entire SMTP chain has been made private.
Just because an SMTP server can authenticate an SMTP client, it does not mean that the mail from the SMTP client was authenticated by the SMTP client when the client received it.
The SMTP client and server must check the result of TLS negotiation to see whether an acceptable degree of authentication and privacy was achieved.
items.constraint: Both the SMTP client and server must check the result of the TLS negotiation to see whether an acceptable degree of authentication and privacy was achieved.
items.object: the result of the TLS negotiation

items.meaning: Ignoring the TLS negotiation check completely invalidates using TLS for security.
The decision about whether acceptable authentication or privacy was achieved is made locally, is implementation-dependent, and is beyond the scope of this document.
SMTP 客户端与服务器应当仔细注意 TLS 协商的结果
items.constraint: The SMTP client and server should note carefully the result of the TLS negotiation.
items.object: the result of the TLS negotiation

items.meaning: 在协商结果无隐私、算法或密钥长度不够强或认证不充分时，客户端可以选择以立即 QUIT 结束 SMTP 会话
items.constraint: the client may choose to end the SMTP session with an immediate QUIT command
items.object: the SMTP session with an immediate QUIT command
items.condition: If the negotiation results in no privacy, or if it results in privacy using algorithms or key lengths that are deemed not strong enough, or if the authentication is not good enough for either party

items.meaning: 在同样条件下，服务器可以选择不再接受任何更多 SMTP 命令
items.constraint: the server may choose to not accept any more SMTP commands
items.object: SMTP commands
items.condition: If the negotiation results in no privacy, or if it results in privacy using algorithms or key lengths that are deemed not strong enough, or if the authentication is not good enough for either party

items.meaning: 删除服务器返回的“250 STARTTLS”响应可发起中间人攻击，使客户端不尝试启动 TLS 会话
为防御此类攻击，客户端与服务器必须能够被配置为：在消息成功传输前，要求对选定主机完成适当密码套件的成功 TLS 协商
items.constraint: both clients and servers MUST be able to be configured to require successful TLS negotiation of an appropriate cipher suite for selected hosts before messages can be successfully transferred
items.action: be able to be configured to require
items.object: successful TLS negotiation of an appropriate cipher suite for selected hosts before messages can be successfully transferred

items.meaning: 还应当提供在可能时使用 TLS 的附加选项
items.constraint: The additional option of using TLS when possible SHOULD also be provided.
items.object: The additional option of using TLS when possible

items.meaning: 实现可以提供记录与给定对端通信时使用了 TLS、并在后续会话未使用 TLS 时产生告警的能力
items.constraint: An implementation MAY provide the ability to record that TLS was used in communicating with a given peer and generating a warning if it is not used in a later session.
items.object: the ability to record that TLS was used in communicating with a given peer and generating a warning if it is not used in a later session

items.meaning: 客户端收到 454 响应时须决定后续动作（继续 SMTP 会话、稍后重试 TLS 或退信）
发生失败或错误时，客户端应假定服务器将来可能协商 TLS，并在后续会话中尝试协商 TLS，直到本地选定的超时发生
items.constraint: the client can assume that the server may be able to negotiate TLS in the future, and should try negotiate TLS in a later session, until some locally-chosen timeout occurs
items.object: TLS in a later session
items.condition: If a failure or error occurs

items.meaning: 到达本地选定超时点时，客户端应把邮件退回发件人
items.constraint: at which point, the client should return the mail to the sender
items.object: the mail to the sender
items.condition: until some locally-chosen timeout occurs, at which point

items.meaning: TLS 握手开始前，所有协议交互都以明文进行，可能被主动攻击者修改
客户端与服务器必须在 TLS 握手完成时丢弃握手开始前获得的一切知识
items.constraint: clients and servers MUST discard any knowledge obtained prior to the start of the TLS handshake upon completion of the TLS handshake
items.object: any knowledge obtained prior to the start of the TLS handshake
items.condition: upon completion of the TLS handshake

items.meaning: STARTTLS extension is not suitable for authenticating the author of an email message unless every hop in the delivery chain, including submission to the first SMTP server, is authenticated.
SMTP-AUTH proposal can be used to authenticate delivery.
MIME security multiparts can be used to authenticate the author of an email message.
SMTP-AUTH proposal offers simpler and more flexible options to authenticate an SMTP client.
SASL EXTERNAL mechanism MAY be used in conjunction with the STARTTLS command to provide an authorization identity.
items.object: in conjunction with the STARTTLS command to provide an authorization identity
items.condition: in conjunction with the STARTTLS command

items.meaning: RFC 2034 is SMTP Service Extension for Returning Enhanced Error Codes.
Section 5 discusses when a server should and should not advertise the STARTTLS extension.
The example indicates that the client needs to issue a new EHLO command.
This document defines an SMTP extension.
An SMTP client may indicate an authentication mechanism to the server.
The extension optionally negotiates a security layer for subsequent protocol interactions during the session.
The extension includes a profile of SASL for SMTP.
本文件所定义的 SMTP 扩展属于该协议
SMTP 客户端可向服务器指明认证机制、进行认证协议交换、可选地为后续交互协商安全层，并在邮件事务中可选地指明邮箱
在邮件事务中可选地指明与向邮件投递系统提交消息的身份相关联的邮箱

可选的客户端初始响应；若存在，则必须按 [BASE64] 第 4 节所述编码，或包含单个字符 "="。

items.object: this response

items.object: any further AUTH commands

items.meaning: AUTH 命令发起客户端与服务器之间的 [SASL] 认证交换，客户端用 AUTH 命令的第一个参数指明所用的 SASL 机制。
If the requested authentication mechanism is invalid, the server rejects the AUTH command with a 504 reply.
If the server supports the ESMTP-CODES extension, it SHOULD return a 5.5.4 enhanced response code.
items.constraint: SHOULD return a 5.5.4 enhanced response code when the server supports the [ESMTP-CODES] extension.
items.object: 5.5.4 enhanced response code
items.condition: If the server supports the [ESMTP-CODES] extension

items.meaning: A server challenge is sent as a 334 reply whose text part contains the BASE64 encoded string supplied by the SASL mechanism.
This challenge MUST NOT contain any text other than the BASE64 encoded challenge.
items.constraint: MUST NOT contain any text other than the BASE64 encoded challenge.
items.object: any text other than the BASE64 encoded challenge

items.meaning: A client response consists of a line containing a BASE64 encoded string.
If the client wishes to cancel the authentication exchange, it issues a line with a single "*".
If the server receives such a response, it MUST reject the AUTH command by sending a 501 reply.
items.constraint: MUST reject the AUTH command by sending a 501 reply if the server receives such a response.
items.object: AUTH command
items.condition: If the server receives such a response

items.meaning: The optional initial response argument to the AUTH command is used to save a round-trip when using authentication mechanisms that support an initial client response.
If the initial response argument is omitted and the chosen mechanism requires an initial client response, the server MUST proceed as defined in Section 5.1 of [SASL].
items.constraint: MUST proceed as defined in Section 5.1 of [SASL] when the initial response argument is omitted and the chosen mechanism requires an initial client response.
items.object: as defined in Section 5.1 of [SASL]
items.condition: If the initial response argument is omitted and the chosen mechanism requires an initial client response

items.meaning: In SMTP, a server challenge that contains no data is defined as a 334 reply with no text part.
The complete response line for a 334 reply with no text part is 334 followed by a space.
The AUTH command is still subject to the line length limitations defined in [SMTP].
If use of the initial response argument would cause the AUTH command to exceed this length, the client MUST NOT use the initial response parameter.
items.constraint: MUST NOT use the initial response parameter if use of the initial response argument would cause the AUTH command to exceed this length.
items.object: initial response parameter
items.condition: If use of the initial response argument would cause the AUTH command to exceed this length

items.meaning:
单个等号
作为初始响应发送的信号表示响应存在但内容为空。

items.condition: If the client cannot BASE64 decode any of the server's challenges

items.meaning: 必须拒绝（而非忽略）BASE64 字母表不允许字符的服务器和客户端。

items.meaning: 客户端可以比较认证前后通告的 SASL 机制，以检测主动降级攻击。
items.constraint: a client MAY compare the advertised SASL mechanisms before and after authentication in order to detect an active down-negotiation attack
items.object: the advertised SASL mechanisms before and after authentication

items.meaning: 客户端在成功完成启用安全层的 SASL 协商后发送的第一条命令
items.constraint: 客户端应在启用安全层的 SASL 协商成功后，把 EHLO 命令作为第一条命令发送
items.object: an EHLO command as the first command
items.condition: after a successful SASL negotiation that results in the enabling of a security layer

items.meaning: 当 TLS 与 SASL 安全层同时生效时的数据编码顺序规定
items.constraint: TLS 编码必须在 SASL 编码之后应用，与两层协商顺序无关
items.object: the TLS encoding after the SASL encoding
items.condition: When an entity (whether it is the client or the server end) is sending data, and both [TLS] and SASL security layers are in effect

items.meaning: 认证命令失败后客户端的可选处理方式
items.constraint: AUTH 命令失败后，客户端可以不进行认证而继续
items.object: without authentication
items.condition: If an AUTH command fails

items.meaning: AUTH 失败后客户端可换用其他机制或凭据重试
items.constraint: AUTH 失败后，客户端可以尝试另一种认证机制或提供不同凭据来重发 AUTH
items.object: another authentication mechanism or present different credentials by issuing another AUTH
items.condition: If an AUTH command fails

items.meaning: 服务器必须实现禁止明文口令机制的配置
items.constraint: 服务器实现必须提供不允许任何明文口令机制的配置，除非已协商 STARTTLS 或存在其他保护机制
items.object: a configuration in which it does NOT permit any plaintext password mechanisms
items.exception: unless either the STARTTLS [SMTP-TLS] command has been negotiated or some other mechanism that protects the session from password snooping has been provided

items.meaning: 站点不应使用无口令窃听保护的明文口令机制配置
items.constraint: 服务器站点不应使用允许明文口令机制而无口令窃听防护的配置
items.object: any configuration which permits a plaintext password mechanism without such a protection mechanism against password snooping

items.meaning: 为保证互操作性必须实现的 SASL 机制
items.constraint: 客户端与服务器实现必须实现运行于 TLS 之上的 [PLAIN] SASL 机制
items.object: the [PLAIN] SASL mechanism running over TLS [TLS] [SMTP-TLS]
items.condition: To ensure interoperability

items.meaning: 一种已被许多现有客户端和服务器实现实现的 SASL 机制。
items.object: CRAM-MD5 SASL mechanism

items.meaning: 用于进行 SASL 认证的 SMTP 命令。
items.action: be the last command in a pipelined group of commands
items.object: AUTH command
items.condition: When the AUTH command is used together with the [PIPELINING] extension
items.exception: when the AUTH command contains an initial response for a SASL mechanism that allows the client to send data first, the SASL mechanism is known to complete in one round-trip, and a security layer is not negotiated by the client

items.meaning: 一种编码方式，<mailbox> 被编码在其中以符合 ESMTP 参数的限制。
从先前 AUTH 命令的授权身份导出的身份（若有）。
MAIL FROM 命令的可选参数，使可信环境中的协作代理能够传递与各条消息关联的授权身份。
中继邮件时携带的 AUTH 参数，其值应与原提交者 <mailbox> 相同。
items.constraint: 若服务器信任客户端已认证的身份并据此认定邮件由所给 <mailbox> 原始提交，则服务器 SHOULD 在向任何支持 AUTH 扩展的其他服务器中继该邮件时提供相同的 <mailbox>。
items.object: the same <mailbox> in an AUTH parameter when relaying the message to any other server which supports the AUTH extension
items.condition: If the server trusts the authenticated identity of the client to assert that the message was originally submitted by the supplied <mailbox>

items.meaning: MAIL FROM 命令的 AUTH 参数，即使客户端未认证，服务器也必须支持。
items.constraint: 声明支持该扩展的服务器即使客户端未对服务器进行认证，也 MUST 支持 MAIL FROM 命令的 AUTH 参数。
items.object: the AUTH parameter to the MAIL FROM command
items.condition: servers that advertise support for this extension; even when the client has not authenticated itself to the server

items.meaning: MAIL FROM 的 AUTH=<> 参数表示邮件的原始提交者未知。
收到 AUTH=<> 时，服务器不得把该邮件视为由 AUTH 命令所得认证身份原始提交。
items.constraint: 服务器 MUST NOT 把该邮件当作由 AUTH 命令产生的认证身份原始提交的邮件处理。
items.object: the message as having been originally submitted by the authenticated identity that resulted from the AUTH command
items.condition: A MAIL FROM parameter of AUTH=<> indicates that the original submitter of the message is not known

items.meaning: 服务器可依认证身份生成 <mailbox> 用于中继时的 AUTH 参数。
items.constraint: 当 MAIL FROM 未提供 AUTH 参数、客户端已认证且服务器认为该邮件为原始提交时，服务器 MAY 依据用户认证身份生成一个 <mailbox>，用于向支持 AUTH 扩展的其他服务器中继时填写 AUTH 参数。
items.object: a <mailbox> from the user's authenticated identity for use in an AUTH parameter when relaying the message to any server which supports the AUTH extension
items.condition: If the AUTH parameter to the MAIL FROM command is not supplied, the client has authenticated, and the server believes the message is an original submission

items.meaning: 服务器生成的 <mailbox> 虽依赖实现，但必须符合 SMTP 语法。
items.constraint: 生成的 <mailbox> 为具体实现相关，但其 MUST 符合 [SMTP] 的语法。
items.object: the syntax of [SMTP]

items.meaning: 实现无法生成合法 <mailbox> 时，中继须发送 AUTH=<>。
items.constraint: 若实现无法生成合法的 <mailbox>，则它在转发该邮件时 MUST 发送 AUTH=<>。
items.object: AUTH=<> when relaying this message
items.condition: If the implementation cannot generate a valid <mailbox>

items.meaning: 服务器不充分信任客户端认证身份或客户端未认证时，须按 AUTH=<> 处理。
items.constraint: 若服务器不充分信任客户端的认证身份，或客户端未认证，则服务器 MUST 按提供了 AUTH=<> 参数的情形行事。
items.object: as if the AUTH=<> parameter was supplied
items.condition: If the server does not sufficiently trust the authenticated identity of the client, or if the client is not authenticated

items.meaning: 服务器可将所提供的 AUTH 参数值写入日志文件。
items.constraint: 服务器 MAY 将所提供的任一 AUTH 参数的值写入日志文件。
items.object: the value of any supplied AUTH parameter to a log file

items.meaning: If an AUTH=<> parameter was supplied explicitly or due to the previous requirement, the server MUST supply AUTH=<> when relaying to any server authenticated using AUTH.
items.constraint: MUST supply the AUTH=<> parameter when relaying the message to any server which it has authenticated to using the AUTH extension.
items.object: the AUTH=<> parameter
items.condition: If an AUTH=<> parameter was supplied, either explicitly or due to the requirement in the previous paragraph

items.meaning: A server MAY treat mailing-list expansion as a new submission and set AUTH to the list or list-administration address when relaying to subscribers.
items.constraint: A server MAY treat expansion of a mailing list as a new submission, setting the AUTH parameter to the mailing list address or mailing list administration address when relaying the message to list subscribers.
items.action: treat expansion of a mailing list as a new submission, setting the AUTH parameter
items.object: expansion of a mailing list as a new submission, with AUTH set to the mailing list address or mailing list administration address
items.condition: when relaying the message to list subscribers

items.meaning: Error codes may be used to indicate various success or failure conditions.
Servers returning enhanced status codes SHOULD use the enhanced codes suggested here.
items.constraint: Servers that return enhanced status codes [ESMTP-CODES] SHOULD use the enhanced codes suggested here.
items.object: the enhanced codes suggested here
items.condition: that return enhanced status codes [ESMTP-CODES]

items.meaning: This response to the AUTH command indicates that the user needs to transition to the selected authentication mechanism.
The selected mechanism SHOULD then work for authentications in subsequent sessions.
items.constraint: The selected mechanism SHOULD then work for authentications in subsequent sessions.
items.object: authentications in subsequent sessions
items.condition: then

items.meaning: 454 4.7.0 indicates Temporary authentication failure.
Response to the AUTH command indicates authentication failed due to a temporary server failure.
In this case the client should not prompt the user for another password.
items.constraint: client SHOULD NOT prompt the user for another password in this case
items.object: the user for another password
items.condition: in this case

items.meaning: The selected authentication mechanism is weaker than server policy permits for that user.
The client should retry with a new authentication mechanism.
items.constraint: client SHOULD retry with a new authentication mechanism
items.object: with a new authentication mechanism
items.condition: This response to the AUTH command indicates that the selected authentication mechanism is weaker than server policy permits for that user.

items.meaning: Authentication failed due to invalid or insufficient authentication credentials.
In this case the client should ask the user to supply new credentials.
items.constraint: client SHOULD ask the user to supply new credentials
items.object: the user to supply new credentials
items.condition: In this case

items.meaning: This response should be returned by any command other than AUTH, EHLO, HELO, NOOP, RSET, or QUIT when server policy requires authentication and authentication is not currently in force.
items.constraint: This response SHOULD be returned by any command other than AUTH, EHLO, HELO, NOOP, RSET, or QUIT when server policy requires authentication in order to perform the requested action and authentication is not currently in force
items.object: by any command other than AUTH, EHLO, HELO, NOOP, RSET, or QUIT
items.condition: when server policy requires authentication in order to perform the requested action and authentication is not currently in force.
items.exception: AUTH, EHLO, HELO, NOOP, RSET, or QUIT

items.meaning: Enhanced status code 538 5.7.11 indicates encryption required for requested authentication mechanism.
对该 AUTH 命令的响应表明：所选认证机制只能在使用加密的底层 SMTP 连接时使用；该响应码仅为历史目的记录。
现代实现不应通告因缺乏加密而不被允许的机制，除非当前已采用足够强度的加密层。
items.constraint: SHOULD NOT advertise mechanisms that are not permitted due to lack of encryption
items.object: mechanisms that are not permitted due to lack of encryption
items.exception: unless an encryption layer of sufficient strength is currently being employed

items.meaning: 增强状态码 5.7.8 表示认证凭据无效。
增强状态码 5.7.9 表示认证机制过弱。
增强状态码 5.7.11 表示所请求的认证机制需要加密。
当服务器因客户端发送的 [BASE64] 响应长于当前所选 SASL 机制可用的最大缓冲区大小而使 AUTH 命令失败时，应返回该增强状态码。
items.constraint: SHOULD be returned when the server fails the AUTH command due to the client sending a [BASE64] response which is longer than the maximum buffer size available for the currently selected SASL mechanism
items.object: This enhanced status code
items.condition: when the server fails the AUTH command due to the client sending a [BASE64] response which is longer than the maximum buffer size available for the currently selected SASL mechanism

items.meaning: 接收待投递或进一步处理消息的 SMTP 服务器必须在消息内容开头插入 "Received:" 头字段（如 [SMTP] 第 4.4 节所述）。
items.constraint: MUST insert the "Received:" header field at the beginning of the message content
items.object: "Received:" header field at the beginning of the message content
items.condition: that receives a message for delivery or further processing

items.meaning: 认证成功后，服务器应（在适当时）在 Received 头字段的 "with" 子句中使用 "ESMTPA" 或 "ESMTPSA" 关键字。
items.constraint: SHOULD use the "ESMTPA" or the "ESMTPSA" keyword in the "with" clause of the Received header field
items.object: the "ESMTPA" or the "ESMTPSA" [SMTP-TT] (when appropriate) keyword in the "with" clause of the Received header field
items.condition: Upon successful authentication

items.meaning: 除另有说明外，所有字母字符不区分大小写。
实现必须以不区分大小写的方式接受这些字符串。
items.constraint: MUST accept these strings in a case-insensitive fashion
items.object: these strings in a case-insensitive fashion

items.meaning: ABNF rule defining xchar as US-ASCII characters excluding '+', '=', SP, and CTL.
ABNF rule for an AUTH= xtext parameter to the MAIL FROM command.
items.constraint: "AUTH=" xtext

items.meaning: auth-param complies with syntax defined by esmtp-param [SMTP].
items.constraint: complies with syntax defined by esmtp-param [SMTP]

items.meaning: The decoded form of the xtext MUST be either a <mailbox> or the two characters "<>".
items.constraint: The decoded form of the xtext MUST be either a <mailbox> or the two characters "<>"
items.object: either a <mailbox> or the two characters "<>"

items.meaning: A client using this extension to get an encrypted tunnel needs to be configured to never send mail to that server when the connection is not mutually authenticated and encrypted.
items.constraint: needs to be configured to never send mail to that server when the connection is not mutually authenticated and encrypted

items.meaning: Before the SASL negotiation has begun, protocol interactions are performed in the clear and may be modified by an active attacker.
items.constraint: performed in the clear and may be modified by an active attacker

items.meaning: Clients and servers MUST discard any knowledge obtained prior to the start of the SASL negotiation upon the establishment of a security layer.
items.constraint: clients and servers MUST discard any knowledge obtained prior to the start of the SASL negotiation upon the establishment of a security layer
items.object: any knowledge obtained prior to the start of the SASL negotiation
items.condition: upon the establishment of a security layer

items.meaning: This mechanism does not protect the TCP port.
items.constraint: does not protect the TCP port

items.meaning: The AUTH=<> parameter prevents such an attack from causing a relayed message and, in the absence of other envelope authentication, from picking up the authentication of the relay client.
items.constraint: prevents such an attack from causing a relayed message and from picking up the authentication of the relay client

items.meaning: 消息提交客户端可以在出现合适的 SASL 机制通告时要求用户进行认证。
当某种 SASL 机制相对于匿名提交没有给客户端带来好处时，提交服务器通告该机制并不可取。
服务器可以实现一种策略：在若干次认证失败后断开连接。
items.constraint: Servers MAY implement a policy whereby the connection is dropped after a number of failed authentication attempts.
items.object: a policy whereby the connection is dropped after a number of failed authentication attempts

items.meaning: 服务器在至少 3 次认证尝试失败之前不应断开连接。
items.constraint: they SHOULD NOT drop the connection until at least 3 attempts to authenticate have failed.
items.object: the connection
items.condition: If they do so

items.meaning: 如果实现支持易受被动窃听攻击的 SASL 机制，那么必须支持至少一种配置，在该配置下，这些机制不会被通告或使用，除非存在 [TLS] 等外部安全层。
items.constraint: the implementation MUST support at least one configuration where these SASL mechanisms are not advertised or used without the presence of an external security layer such as [TLS].
items.object: at least one configuration where these SASL mechanisms are not advertised or used without the presence of an external security layer such as [TLS]
items.condition: If an implementation supports SASL mechanisms that are vulnerable to passive eavesdropping attacks (such as [PLAIN])

items.meaning: 双向认证与安全层配合使用时，可以让发送方在一定程度上确信消息已成功送达下一跳。
IANA 更新了按本文档第 3 节定义的 Authentication SMTP 服务扩展的注册信息。
一份被引用的参考文献条目，即 RFC 2034《SMTP Service Extension for Returning Enhanced Error Codes》。
第 14 节的标题名，说明这一节规定的是通过 TLS 使用 SASL PLAIN 机制时的附加要求。
一种 SASL 认证机制；当服务器未提供证书或证书校验失败时，客户端不得使用该机制进行认证。
items.constraint: 如果服务器未提供证书，或者证书校验失败，客户端不得尝试使用 SASL PLAIN 机制进行认证。
items.object: SASL PLAIN mechanism
items.condition: If the server has not provided any certificate, or if the certificate verification fails

items.meaning: SMTP 客户端；在 TLS 协商成功之后，客户端必须把服务器证书中的服务器身份与它自己对该服务器主机名的理解进行比对。
items.constraint: TLS 协商成功后，客户端必须将服务器证书中呈现的身份与自己对服务器主机名的理解进行比对。
items.object: its understanding of the server hostname against the server's identity as presented in the server Certificate message
items.condition: After a successful [TLS] negotiation

items.meaning: 一种 SASL 认证机制；如果主机名与证书身份的匹配失败，客户端不得使用该机制进行认证。
items.constraint: 如果匹配失败，客户端不得尝试使用 SASL PLAIN 机制进行认证。
items.object: SASL PLAIN mechanism
items.condition: If the match fails

items.meaning: SMTP 客户端；客户端必须使用自己打开连接时所用的服务器主机名，作为与服务器证书中所表示的服务器名进行比较的取值。
items.constraint: 客户端必须使用打开连接时所用的服务器主机名，作为与证书中表示的服务器名比较的取值。
items.object: the server hostname it used to open the connection as the value to compare against the server name as expressed in the server certificate

key_manifest.note: ★ 「缓存命中时产物可复现」可保证；★ 「重新调用同一模型能否逐字节相同」**不一定成立**
